opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – UK Office (deadline 15 September)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport. Grants typically range £1,500‑£5,000, with exceptional awards up to £6,000.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health (deadline 1 December)

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year (up to £30,000 total for up to three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and others in health‑related fields are also welcome. Preference for those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration and early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan. Grants up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 over three years) can fund travel, conference, publication and other project costs, but not consumables, salaries or capital items.
